summary: Static ArgoCD ApplicationSet promotion manifest for messenger, mail, social, and community backbone microservices on the oyatie-cloud-provider dev track.
claim_boundary: Static GitOps promotion manifest only. This slice defines the ArgoCD ApplicationSet source of truth for dev-track promotion and validates its structure locally. It does not perform a live ArgoCD sync, prove app health, deploy images, verify real image signatures, update hosted branch-protection rules, or run hosted CI.

facets.F1_simplicity: A single ApplicationSet list generator enumerates the four backbone services instead of four drifting Application files.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: The manifest uses tenant-isolated namespaces, dev targetRevision, ServerSideApply, self-heal/prune, cosign-required annotations, and audit-chain event annotations aligned to ADR-0349.
facets.F3_adversarial: Local structural validation checks service count, chart path existence, unique namespaces, image digest shape, required Helm parameters, required sync options, and CI path-filter coverage.
facets.F5_quality: YAML parsing, ApplicationSet structural assertions, workflow parsing, dependency-seam, honest-claims, and diff hygiene are part of this run.
facets.F7_security_privacy: Each generated Application targets a single microservice namespace with namespace-isolation annotations; no secrets or credentials are embedded.
facets.F11_observability: Generated Applications set the OTLP collector endpoint Helm value and deploy audit-chain event annotations. Live collector/sync evidence remains pending.

verification.evidence: ApplicationSet parsed with 4 apps; chart/value paths exist; namespaces are unique; digest shapes, cosign annotations, Helm parameters, sync options, and workflow path filters are present.

verification.command: ./bin/oya gate validate dependency-seam --repo-root . --registry registry/dependency-rationales.json --evidence <all backbone evidence>
verification.evidence: 6 subchecks: 3 pass, 2 report-only, 1 skipped, 0 fail, 2 diagnostics, 0 blocking

verification.command: ./bin/oya gate validate honest-claims --clear-default-corpus <tasks + ApplicationSet + workflow + evidence corpus>
verification.evidence: 5 documents, 836 lines, 173 implementation plans, 0 dependency edges, 0 serialization edges, 0 global artifact writes, 26 legacy missing split-rule rows

non_claims: No live ArgoCD controller sync, health status, or rollback evidence is produced by this slice.
No real signed image digest or cosign verification result is claimed; placeholder digests remain static promotion seams until image build/signing lands.
No hosted GitHub branch-protection, live CI runtime-run, cluster namespace creation, or Kubernetes deployment is claimed.
